title: Kickoff: NEAT seeded with a cloned pilot
text:
Goal: >= 98% landed between the flags on 1,000 unseen flights with wind 15, turbulence 1.5 and a floating boulder, by Wednesday 4 November 18:00.

Built today: the world (wind seeded per flight, the boulder as a static rock, training wheels), a hand-written pilot tuned with CMA-ES (500 unseen flights: calm 100% landed, wind+turbulence 93.8%, with the boulder 74.2%), and a 13-24-4 network cloned from it with DAgger (about 82% landed over mixed worlds). Every genome in NEAT's first population is a copy of that network with small noise; its 24 hidden neurons are protected from deletion.

Run A started: six stages (calm, steady push, gusts, turbulence, boulder, polish). Generation 0 already landed 99% on 100 fresh calm flights.
